data_source.query:
FROM kibana_sample_data_logs
| SORT @timestamp
| EVAL t = now()
| EVAL buckets = CASE(timestamp <= t AND timestamp >= t - 1 hour, "Last hour", "Other")
| STATS sum = SUM(bytes), count = COUNT_DISTINCT(clientip) by buckets, extension.keyword
| EVAL sum_last_hour = CASE(buckets == "Last hour", sum), sum_rest = CASE(buckets == "Other", sum), count_last_hour = CASE(buckets == "Last hour", count), count_rest = CASE(buckets == "Other", count)
| STATS sum_last_hour = MAX(sum_last_hour), sum_rest = MAX(sum_rest), count_last_hour = MAX(count_last_hour), count_rest = MAX(count_rest) by buckets, extension.keyword
| EVAL total_bytes = TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(sum_last_hour, 0::LONG) + COALESCE(sum_rest, 0::LONG))
| EVAL total_visits = TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(count_last_hour, 0::LONG) + COALESCE(count_rest, 0::LONG))
| KEEP count_last_hour, total_visits, total_bytes, sum_last_hour, extension.keyword
| STATS count_last_hour = SUM(count_last_hour), total_visits  = SUM(total_visits), bytes_transform = SUM(total_bytes), bytes_transform_last_hour = SUM(sum_last_hour) BY extension.keyword
| RENAME total_visits as `Unique Visits (Total)`, count_last_hour as `Unique Visits (Last hour)`, bytes_transform as `Bytes(Total)`, bytes_transform_last_hour as `Bytes(Last hour)`, extension.keyword as `Type`
| SORT `Unique Visits (Total)` DESC

config.title: SUM(bytes) & Unique Visits (Total - MB) & Bytes(Total) of Type
